verdict.rationale: Ollama is a model runtime with a desktop app, so it could plausibly act as an MCP client and the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack shows Ollama itself connecting to or consuming MCP servers. Launching or connecting third-party agents such as Claude Code or Codex is a separate capability of those tools, not Ollama's own MCP-client support, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
